Hi Nora / Samir,

Thanks again for running the pilot with the team — the benchmark run completed last week and Diego/Karthik have the detailed logs and slides ready for a readout. We want to walk through:

- High-level throughput & p99 latency numbers
- Environment and test harness details (to validate reproducibility)
- Action items: next steps for Dedicated sizing and cost estimates

Proposed 45-minute slots (PST):
- Thu 19 Feb, 09:30–10:15
- Thu 19 Feb, 13:00–13:45
- Fri 20 Feb, 11:00–11:45

Please let us know which time works and who from your side will join (eng + procurement/security if possible). I’m copying Diego (SE) and Karthik (infra) to cover the technical details.

Best,

- Engineers: Samir will join; I hope to have our infra lead Amit Shah on the call but he'll only be available later in the afternoon.
- Procurement: looped in; they need a draft SOW and a rough cost estimate to book budget.
- Security: we also have to confirm SOC2 evidence availability before the readout — our security lead may ask questions.

Thanks Nora — Fri 20 Feb 11:00 PST works for our side.

Agenda I propose (45m):
1) 5m Introductions & goals for the readout (Marissa)
2) 15m Benchmark results and latency/throughput breakdown (me + Karthik)
3) 10m Repro steps, infra config, and open logs (Karthik)
4) 10m Procurement/Q&A next steps (Marissa + Procurement)
5) 5m Security calls / evidence pointers (Evelyn)

Karthik — I’ll hand off the run artifacts and the Readout Deck (attached) to you to call out any infra caveats.

Evelyn — could you prepare a very short checklist of the SOC2 items we can reference in the call? I attached a stub SOC2 report we usually share; we can redact as needed.

Thanks,

Hi all — quick security note ahead of tomorrow's readout:

I attached the SOC2 stub we typically share and a short checklist below we will call out on the readout:
- Data flow diagram and retention policy (we'll point to the public docs)
- Encryption at rest & in transit (KMS + TLS versions)
- Access controls and audit logging (how to request audit logs)

If ClearSight can share a list of compliance questions in advance, I can prep specific artifacts. Otherwise, we'll cover the high-level controls and next steps for any detailed asks.

Regards,
